authorInfo.bio: James Grant (1822–1887) is the credited author of this historical edition. Works available in this collection include Jane Seton; or, The King's Advocate: A Scottish Historical Romance, One of the Six Hundred: A Novel, Under the Red Dragon: A Novel. The linked author record provides further bibliographic details.

description: "The Adventures of Rob Roy" by James Grant is a historical novel written in the mid-19th century. The book explores the life and exploits of Rob Roy MacGregor, a Scottish folk hero and outlaw from the clan MacGregor during a tumultuous period in Scottish history.
